article.title: Patrick Stewart, a perceptive patriarch in 'Star Trek' and 'X-Men,' dies at 86
article.summary: Stewart was raised by an abusive father but became best known for playing kind, paternal leaders who united families of misfits. (Image credit: Jack Taylor)
